description: This file contains unit tests for the Abseil synchronization mutex implementation, including tests for mutex behavior, condition variables, deadlock detection, timeouts, and various concurrency scenarios.

classes.name: TimeoutTest
classes.description: A test fixture for timeout-related mutex and condition variable tests, parameterized by various timeout scenarios.

classes.name: MutexVariableThreadCountTest
classes.description: A test fixture for concurrency tests parameterized by thread count.

classes.name: CondVarWaitDeadlock
classes.description: A parameterized test class for deadlock scenarios involving condition variables.

classes.name: LockWhenTestStruct
classes.description: A helper struct for testing Mutex::LockWhen behavior.

classes.name: AcquireFromConditionStruct
classes.description: A helper struct for testing conditions that acquire other mutexes.

classes.name: DequeueAllWakeableBugStruct
classes.description: A helper struct for testing a bug related to waking readers in Mutex.

classes.name: ReaderDecrementBugStruct
classes.description: A helper struct for testing a bug where reader counters are decremented incorrectly.

methods.name: CreatePool

methods.name: ScheduleAfter

methods.name: CheckSumG0G1

methods.description: Tests mutex try-lock behavior.

methods.name: TestRW
methods.description: Tests read-write mutex behavior.

methods.name: MyTurn

methods.name: TestAwait

methods.name: TestSignalAll

methods.name: TestCVTimeout
methods.description: Tests condition variable wait with timeout.

methods.name: G0GE2

methods.name: TestTime
methods.description: Performs various timeout and deadline tests on mutex and condition variable.

methods.name: TestMuTime
methods.description: Tests mutex timeout behavior.

methods.name: TestCVTime
methods.description: Tests condition variable timeout behavior.

methods.name: EndTest
methods.description: Helper to end a test iteration and invoke callback.
